async function obtainTwelveCoal(bot) {
    // The function checks if the required amount of coal has been gathered; if so, it stops. Otherwise, it first attempts to mine any nearby coal or deepslate coal ore until a target amount is reached. If that fails, it performs two short exploratory searches in different directions. After each search that finds coal, it attempts to mine more nearby ore. If all attempts fail to reach the target, it throws an error indicating the search was exhausted.
}
